svg.title: Warn On Cache Busts: notice when the prompt cache stops hitting
svg.desc: WarnOnCacheBusts runs in the after_model_request hook and only observes. For each response it compares cache_read_tokens with the cacheable prefix the conversation has established. Requests 2 to 4 read back the whole prefix; request 5 reads back 4K of an established 40K, so it emits a CacheBustWarning with reason unexpected. Collapses explained by an expired cache, compaction or unreported usage do not warn.
